reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "55aab6efb6e8dd510050e23b876ff25792e39e54: fix(appset): reverted Gitlab SCM HasPath search and consider 404 errors as file not found", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: ApplicationSet generators using GitLab SCM provider with HasPath search will handle 404 HTTP responses differently, treating them as file-not-found rather than errors.

proposed.statement: GitLab SCM HasPath search behavior is reverted and 404 errors are now treated as file-not-found in ApplicationSet generators.
